newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bomb threat delays ruling on Bulgaria bank case.
newsitem.headline: Bomb threat delays ruling on Bulgaria bank case.

text.p: An insolvency suit against Bulgaria's state-owned Mineralbank was postponed indefinitely on Wednesday after a bomb threat closed the court building, a bank official said.
Police sealed off the Sofia courthouse after an anonymous telephone call warned that a bomb was planted in the building. A police search found nothing, state radio said.
The radio quoted an unidentified law official as saying the bomb threat was aimed at delaying the court ruling on the Mineralbank insolvency.
The central bank placed Mineralbank in receivership on May 17 and filed an insolvency suit at the Sofia City Court two weeks later.
The court has twice delayed ruling on the case since then, saying it lacked sufficient information on the bank's assets and liabilities at the moment when the BNB filed the insolvency suit.
